turns.content: Morning. First order of business: the e2e suite flaked twice overnight on the segment rollover test. Can we quarantine it until someone has time to make the temp-dir handling hermetic? It keeps masking real failures in the merge queue.
Quarantined it and filed a ticket with the two failing runs linked. The rest of the suite is green, so the merge queue is unblocked.

Next: certificate renewal for the ingest edge is due soon and last time it was a manual scramble. Can we put the renewal on the automation calendar with a dry-run a week ahead so we are not doing it live again?
Added the renewal with a dry-run reminder a week ahead, and I linked the runbook section that lists which services need a bounce after the swap.

Now the actual decision I wanted to make today. Paging is a mess: half the escalations land in the general ops room and drown. Let's route page escalations to #dw-crow-watch going forward, keep the general room for chatter, and update the oncall doc to match.
Done. I updated the oncall doc so escalations point at that channel, and I left the general room wiring in place for non-paging chatter only.
Also the benchmark rig numbers have been noisy since the kernel update on the lab box. Can you rerun last week's baseline so we are not comparing against a moving target?
Rerunning the baseline now with the same pinned inputs; I will attach the fresh numbers to the perf tracking issue when it finishes.
One more: the mirror sync cron for the docs site has been silently skipping weekends because of the maintenance window overlap. Can you shift it an hour so it stops colliding?
Shifted the mirror sync out of the maintenance window and added a failure notification so a skipped run is visible instead of silent.
